title: Splat video
description: A phone clip you can step into: looking up past a level-crossing signal into a summer cumulus, rebuilt as Gaussian splats. The signal and its catenary are one rigid silhouette well in front of the cloud, the cumulus tops boil and climb while it plays, and dragging leans you round the signal so the wires slide across the sky.
intent: Gets as close to 4DV.ai as one webcam allows: a sharp, native-frame-rate subject with no crossfade over a splat room built once, with exposure that follows the video, on a real player interface (play, scrub, speed, sound, look, back to lens) on the light palette.
